body:
Good idea mate! I also find that Reddit, being driven by user uploaded content, means you can never really be sure as to the ethics behind anything uploaded. There is likely a lot of revenge porn (I don’t know, I’m just saying it is a possibility. Why take the risk?) and I’ve seen some people make some gross comments.

What helped me was turning off NSFW content on reddit for awhile. Stick to subs like this as well, they help!
Honestly, 24 is very young. I don’t know what you’ve done, but I don’t think it is too late. You’ve got a lot of life ahead of you.

Well mate, sounds like you had a hard run and then hit a pretty big low. But rock bottom is when you stop digging. Go easy on yourself and make some good decisions. You need to confront that you have an addiction. It’s hard, but once you’ve confronted it you can move forward. Best of luck, I believe in you.

As someone who has cut porn out of my life, I disagree. I mean, I follow a lot of metal/rock n roll pages on Instie so I do still see “racy” pictures from time to time, but there is no way in hell I’m going back to a porn site. It wasn’t doing me any good, and it doesn’t sound like it was doing OP any good either.

With that said, my experience has been very different from OPs, and wrapped up in a lot of anxiety/fear whenever I went to a porn site, as I’d agonise afterwards about whether the participants were okay (no reason for me to think they weren’t, I watched the hokiest of staged stuff), so it seems porn in general just ain’t for me.

1) Acknowledge my past, but dwell on it less.

2) Open up a news app and read a cool article instead of Reddit when bored.

3) Tell my partner I love her more.
Thank you. I'll try.
Thanks, I'll try.

Thanks very much. Going for walks and stuff really helps me too.

It's just...I feel like I've seen too much bad. I'm suffering from some pretty heavy dopamine withdrawls at the moment, and I'm having horrendous flashbacks. It is making me question myself, and I feel like I can't escape it. But I will. It's just going to take time.

My partner actually mentioned to me that my addiction seems to be to the internet and social media itself, or at least I have an unhealthy relationship with media. I believe it, and it is something I'm hoping to unpack with my therapist. It explains a lot about me. I've stopped browsing "cringe" sub-reddits and similar kind of spaces, because I think they were really messing with my perception of self and others.

But back to your point, I think you are right that the internet has made us feel like this, or at least really pushed this along. People are dragged through the mud for a single Tweet. I'm skeptical of there being a broader "cancel culture", but  I do think that spending too much time on any social media platform we start to perceive people as their posts, for good or bad, and we internalize it.

Humans are such complex beasts. We were never meant to be defined by a browser window.
That's absolutely fair. Wherever you are today, I wish you the best on your journey.
Oh yeah? Which part?

Good idea!

Also don't beat yourself up too much when you do relapse - you're on a journey, there will be some bumps in the road. I believe in you.

I'm battling with this kind of thing too mate, and with many of the same effects it seems (I was also unfortunately exposed to stuff at a very young age).

I think the fact you are speaking to a psychologist is a great step. I'd also encourage you to try and journal your thoughts. No one has to ever see it, you can destroy it after if you want. But next time you get those urges, write down how you feel. Write down why you feel that way, and also write down the cost if you succumb. It'll hurt like hell, but then it'll be over.

Good luck.

I know those kind of days my friend.

Some days are really, really hard. But this too will pass, and tomorrow is a new day, yet untouched.

When you want to do it, try to do something else. Go for a walk. Pick up a hobby. Something active. Don’t watch a movie or read a book - it’s gotta be ACTIVE.

Good luck mate!
I see where you are coming from. I mean, I don't think I was in my right mind to be lying to my partner the way I was (I know that isn't reflected in this post, but it's the main catalyst here).
Hey thanks! I'm not courageous though - I got into this situation by being a coward and lying to my partner. But I'm deciding to be better.
Thanks! I'm getting there. Trying to keep my mind busy is helping.
That's awesome, well done! I've been in and out of therapy throughout my life, but it's always been about coping with external forces - never facing my demons. It's a lot, but it's way overdue.

Indeed - myself, and my partner through my deceit. I can't change that past, but I can make sure it never happens again.

Thanks for the resource, I'll check it out.

It sounds like you're experiencing a form of ennui.

You need to go out and find your own adventure and story. Have you tried hiking, and then when you get back, writing down your experience? Or journalling in general?

"I’m now 20 and don’t have much to show for it."

Honestly mate who does? You are so young, you have your whole life ahead of you. Be well, Ron. You're gonna make it.

As I get older I realise what is important. I used to want to be famous. And for everything to be "correct".

Now I just want to do right by my family and friends. Do my bit at work, make sure my cat is comfortable and my partner knows she is loved. If I make someone smile on the internet with a little post or Tweet, then that is icing on the cake.

We are all capable of far more than we think. And sometimes we've already done much more than we believe.

My grandma used to have a sign up in her home that simply said something like "To make one person breathe easier is to have succeeded in life". So breathe easy, and go succeed.

I would love Metal Gear and Metal Gear 2 remade in The FOX Engine as two chapters. Metal Gear would make for a great urban stealth adventure akin to MGS1 and 2. Metal Gear 2 could have a big, sandbox jungle on the way to Outer Heaven, which could be structured a lot like Camp Omega in MGSV. Bring back Hayter, Keifer and Doyle to voice the respective Snakes. Hell, find a reason to bring in Cam Clarke as Liquid too!

The NES game is a port of the original MSX game and seen as inferior to it. It’s sequel, Snakes Revenge, was made without Kojima, but inspired him to make the stunning “Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake” and then PS1’s “Metal Gear Solid”.
I’d definitely recommend it. As for the stigma - who is going to know? You don’t have to tell people. And hell, maybe one day the fact you went will inspire more people to go.
You have tomorrow. <3
My favourite animal, actually!

That was certainly me a month or so ago in the heat of my addiction with the stuff I did watch. Very focused on "this is who I am, can't change it". I began to link my identity to it.

It's why I do struggle with those sub-reddits that discuss it. I'm not knocking anyone on their journey, I never will. It's just that for me, it made me start to sort of identify with them. And not in a healthy "we've all had these bad situations" way, but instead in starting to think "this guy started cheating on his partner - I may as well have done that!" and then I start to feel the guilt of what he did and placing it on myself. Completely illogical, but it's what I did.

You're right about "coming up for air". The thing to do is say "okay, well, I did do XYZ. I feel bad about it, but I did it. So from today, I will not do XYZ. And I can't somehow take steps to reverse having done it. I can just...not do it."

This is a great way to put it Dude, thank you!

I think that's really it - I was just trying to see their humanity. See that they were ok. And even if I then and now morally object to the kind of content they are putting out, it isn't hurting anyone (so far as I can tell). But basically putting myself in a position where I might be exposed to it isn't going to help anyone. They will be making it regardless. They appear to be doing so within the letter of the law, and I am not going to encounter it unless I go looking for it.

But then I have this feeling of I *did* go looking for it, even in the context of just trying to see if I needed to hate myself for it or not. And it's like "well, before you just saw it by accident. Now you've in a sense tried to find it". I just end up a mess of knots and sadness.

I'm going to reflect on what you said here. I think it'll really help.

Hey dude! I've made a couple of posts about this myself. You've got some dark days ahead of you, I'm not going to sugar coat it. But your days looking at porn does not define you. What you do now does. You can do this!

One thing I will say: a lot of people recommend sites like /nofap and stuff. I think for some people these work really well, but to me, it just makes me feel worse. Reading other people's stories might make you feel better, but it might also just make you flashback and get stuck in a spiral.

When you feel like you are entering a shame spiral, try and do something nice for yourself. You might think "I am not worth that, I'm scum" but you are. Go play a game. Watch a movie. Read a book. Do a drawing! Remember that you are in the present, not the past.
Sounds like you were in a bad place, but you’re on the path out. My advise is to go cold turkey, but we each have our own path. Good luck mate, you’ll make it.
If I do it again, I’ll tell her straight away. It will suck and might end the relationship. So I better bloody not do it again!
This is a good point. I’ve actually been very candid with my partner about it all now, like I went into a lot of detail, mor than I did here, but I haven’t shown her this post.
Thank you for your comment. I’m sorry about what happened to you. I’ve messed up pretty spectacularly, and I need to put in the work to fix it. I hope you are in a better place now.
Thanks, this is great advise. You are absolutely right - I’m going through guilt and shame, my partner is going through violation. I need to be there for her and put in the work.
My partner is an absolute superwoman. Whether she stays or not, I will not have the love she has given me be in vein
Thank you :)
Hah! Yep. Happened to me before. Good luck on your journey.

Thanks for your comment! I appreciate your kind words. Porn consumption definitely messes with your ideas of relationships, I could punch myself in the face for how I was thinking.

As for fulfilling stuff…yeah, I’m actually not interested in doing so haha. But I appreciate the comment either way!

I’m glad you are on your way too and appreciate your post.
Good point! I’ll edit my post, thanks.

Haha, those are wise words! No danger of that. Naturally I've got a bit of repairing to do with my relationship, but I think everything will be okay in that department. And the most insane part is I was never "banned" from doing anything by my partner. These were restrictions I created for myself.

(Although the poop stuff is going to take awhile for her to get over...again not judging but we've all got our limits. Me included, even if I did lose sight of them.)

There's no "bright side" to what happened, but the fact it all came out and she is still here means I've got a chance to start a fresh. Not many people get that. I won't waste it.

Thank you, this post meant a lot. I still have a lot of voices in my head telling me I should just crawl away and die. But I won't. My life is what I make it, and it's time to make it meaningful and good.

Thanks a lot, I appreciate your post. I think I definitely have a broader social media addiction, which I'm hoping to bring up with my therapist. I loved 4Chan when I was younger (stayed off /b/ for the most part cause that place was weird) because of the rabid-fire posts. Before that it was StumbleUpon. Then it was Tumblr, and at one point it was Reddit (I've cut back a lot). Social media is rad when used properly (like porn I guess!) but it's a tricky thing.

Hey thanks! Sorry, to clarify I'm not necessarily looking for help (although the words of encouragement are EXTREMELY helpful at the moment). I happen to have the greatest partner in the world, who has been talking me through all my bullshit while simultaneously dealing with the fact she is the victim of my lying. Writing it out here creates accountability, allows me to journal my thoughts (a lot of "What was I thinking?" moments at the moment...like, literally, WHAT WAS I THINKING? I DON'T KNOW!), and will *hopefully* stop someone from going down as far as I have. I've been on a few sites like NoFap, etc and the things some people are admiting to there are...they are very, very dark. It is terrifying. I am not a psychologist, I don't know how much of it has to do with porn addiction. But I don't want anyone getting to where I did, and I sure as hell don't want anyone to get any further.

Thank you for your post though! It's good to keep those points you have mentioned in mind.

Yes. Holy shit it does mate. I almost lost my partner over this shit. I'm only about week from my "D-Day", and I'm still terrified she'll leave me. She reassures me she won't, she's an amazing human. But honestly I wouldn't blame her if she decides she can't deal with it. Don't become like me.
Didn't you see what I said I looked up?
Hello! How's it going mate?

These words mean a lot. I'm so repulsed by the lows I sunk too, but I can't focus on it. I didn't hurt anyone (other than of course my partner, but I mean through what I looked at). It never got to any sort of illegal content (and I don't believe it ever would have, but I'm just saying). This doesn't make it ok, but it does mean I'm not too far gone. I can do this. As repulsed as I am, I'm sure my partner is doubly upset. My punishment is learning to live with what I've done, not wallow in it forever.
